text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting for you, my brilliant
gemstones! ☆ You were the
only team that
succeeded in solving all three riddles!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
First off, allow me to congratulate you.
You've all done well to make
it here, using
your intellect to overcome multiple
hurdles.

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
However! ♪ The audition isn't over just
yet, remember? The time has
come for you
all to propose to my racewear!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Racewear, I promised myself that I'd get
my hands on you. So here I
am!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
...That's it? Awfully straightforward,
aren't
you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah,
if the cute Curren puts on cute
racewear, then she'll
become the cutest in
the universe! That's all there is to it. ♪

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
That's some confidence you have there.
But you've shown me
throughout today's
audition that you can back it up with
talent!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Your unwavering self-assurance is truly
beautiful! Now let's see, next
up is...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Me! I'm Haru Urara, and my dream is to
finish first in a race!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
That's why I need you, racewear. Once I
put you on, I'm sure I'll be all
sparkly and
get a big boost of energy!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
So racewear, please! Run with me, and
we'll win lots and lots of races
together!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I see, so your goal is to finish first. I
respect your passion for not only
fun, but
also victory!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um... I've always admired the muses.
Whenever they run, everyone
watching
always breaks into smiles and laughter.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I want to make the crowd smile when I run,
too. But I can't do it by
myself... so I want
you to help me, racewear.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It's not only the spectators,
either... I also
want to make my friends
and everyone
around me happy... So, please!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
That's a wonderful wish of yours. I know
you're a kind and gentle soul
after
watching you today.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Racewear serves as an Umamusume's armor
on the track. And I've heard that Ms.
Beauty's works are not only beautiful, but
top-class in
functionality to boot.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
My dream is to stand on the turf as an
active racer for as long as I
possibly can.
That's why you're the perfect companion
for me!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
...It's not every day I hear someone
praise
my wedding dresses for
their functionality.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I believe that the beauty of optimization
isn't inferior to any other
type of beauty.
Please protect me, so I can keep on
running.

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I'm touched by how much you believe in
my dresses! ♪ What a lovely
proposal!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
...All right,
I believe we have one proposal
left?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
First,
I wish to thank you for giving me the
opportunity to enter this
audition, Ms.
Beauty.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Second, allow me to apologize. When I
originally expressed my intent
to enter the
audition, it was not out of a desire to
obtain your racewear.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Captain? Upon discovering everyone's
aspirations, I have determined it my duty
to help them realize those ambitions. As
such, may I have your permission to join
them?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
In truth...
I simply felt a burning desire to
discover why everyone else
longed for the
racewear you designed.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yet as I went through the audition, I
learned that each of my friends
had
projected their own ideals onto your
racewear.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Urara's ideal was pure and genuine—to run
alongside her friends, and
win.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Rice's ideal was altruistic—to make
everyone around her smile with joy. And
true to that belief,
she never hesitated in extending a
helping hand.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno's ideal was practical—to prolong her
racing career for as long as
possible.
Something we Umamusume all dream of,
perhaps.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
And last but not least, Curren's ideal was
simple, but steadfast—to
fully express as
her cute self.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's because I want the cutest
racewear ever.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
All of them wished to give shape to their
ideals. And they trusted in
Ms. Beauty's
racewear to do just that.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Proudly wearing a physical representation
of your ideals is akin to declaring your
determination to realize them. The
peoples' reaction becomes a source of
motivation.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Upon understanding this,
a new fire was lit
within me. Now I too, wish
to adorn myself
in my ideals.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I aspire to devote myself to my people and
work for their cause. Thus, I ask for your
favor, racewear... that I may never forget
to blaze new
paths forward.

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I doubt I can fully imagine the burden of
the responsibilities you
shoulder... but
your passion is simply beautiful!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I think it's about time I
announce the results of today's

audition! ☆ Curren Chan, Fine Motion,
Ikuno Dictus...

text_block_list.name: All Three
text_block_list.text: Yes?!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower, and Haru Urara...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Uuugh...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: What's wrong, Rice?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
N-no, it's nothing. I was just thinking,
wasn't this audition supposed to
judge us
on our intellect?

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
The theme is, "Those who strive for beauty
must also possess
intellect"! I eagerly await
the participation of undiscovered 
diamonds! ♪

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I... wasn't much help in solving the
riddles...

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Oh my, oh my, what's this about? Who said that the muse candidates would be judged only by intellect?

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Those who strive for beauty must also
possess intellect!" But at the
same time,
"Possessing intellect doesn't equate to
beauty!"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Inspiration, friendship, devotion, and
passion—you all have shown me
the
pinnacle of beauty!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I'm absolutely flowing with
inspiration right now! So
much so that I
want to rush straight back to my desk and
get to work!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? Does that mean I'm included, too?

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Ahem! Without any further ado, I will now
announce the results of the
audition.

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
All five of you passed! And with flying
colors!
